head: working-tree
subject: Typed subject alternative name matchers
change: CertificateValidationContext.match_typed_subject_alt_names (Envoy v3 field 15) is decoded from SDS secrets and inline CDS transport sockets. SanMatcher carries an optional san_type; the TLS verifier restricts typed matchers to EMAIL/DNS/URI/IP SAN entries, formats IP SANs as RFC 5952 text (IPv4 dotted and IPv6 with longest-run compression), and keeps legacy match_subject_alt_names matching only textual SANs. OTHER_NAME and OID matching fail closed.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/tls_material.zig covers typed DNS/IP matching, type mismatch rejection, legacy matchers ignoring IP SANs, IPv4 and IPv6 formatting including longest-run compression and malformed lengths. src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig and src/grpc/xds/sds/secret_tests.zig cover typed matcher decoding and OTHER_NAME rejection.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='xdstp' -Dtest-filter='xDS TLS' -Dtest-filter='typed' --summary all

full_library.notes: Several earlier full runs under host load 12-45 failed only unrelated timing-sensitive cases (WSS/HTTP2 handshake budgets, MQTT journal retries and one control-plane TLS reload) or hung on I/O starvation; each failed case passed in isolation, every module subset passed, and the final full run passed.

notes: Typed SAN matchers are an Envoy v3 feature; grpc-core currently parses only legacy match_subject_alt_names, so this is Envoy compatibility beyond gRPC parity.
